Presented file
Phase 4 of the Compose migration is in positional-phase4.tar.gz. The archive has only the changed and new files, laid out from the repo root. Extract it from the repo root with tar xzf positional-phase4.tar.gz.

What changed

Accent Colors is now a Compose screen built on a tested AccentPalette. Tapping the color that is already selected does nothing; tapping a new one recreates the screen.
Custom Locations is now a Compose screen.
The menu has the same five actions as before: Save, Set and Save, Set Only, Delete all and Help. Delete all now asks for confirmation in a dialog.
Each saved place has its own delete button, replacing swipe-to-delete.
Tapping a place fills in the fields; long-pressing it applies the place and closes the screen.
Coordinate parsing accepts a decimal comma and checks the latitude and longitude ranges.
Room now uses one shared LocationDatabase instead of opening and closing the database on every call. The saved-places list updates automatically.
Saving runs through NonCancellable, so “Set and Save” no longer loses the insert when the screen closes.
Added two new test files, AccentPaletteTest and CoordinateInputTest.
Updated the README’s phase table: Phase 4 is done and Phase 5 is next.
I couldn’t compile this here because the sandbox can’t reach Google’s Maven repository. The CI run is the real check.
